Reasonable but incomplete. (1) It depends on Alpaca answering; set a date to revisit if no answer arrives, so research is not paused indefinitely. summary: Self-review by the same Claude Code session that wrote the analyses - it can catch overstatement against the saved evidence but is not independent. Two claims were challenged (S6: 002 did not fail on cost alone; D2: 'conservative' covers the spread component only) and the decision was challenged for depending on an external reply with no fallback date. No claim was rejected. An independent review would need a different reviewer, for example the owner or a separately authorized model, which is currently UNAVAILABLE.
